request.reason: Keep the three exact evidence-backed pre-finish criteria explicitly numbered for current acceptanceEvidence, while expressing candidate-tag, post-publication, local install, and cleanup steps as later-stage unnumbered Contract conditions. This follows the lifecycle boundary where these outputs cannot exist before the tag/Release and prevents any future-stage assertion from being treated as verified early.

value: A1: The product/source diff changes only the 16 declared product paths; workspace/package identity is plain stable SemVer 1.0.1, localized version/distribution guidance is consistent, and historical v1.0.0 and v1.0.1-rc.2 identities remain separate. The exact six required Work Item/parity pages are governance projections, not additional product-source scope.

A2: The declared Rust workspace verification and every required repository gate pass for the exact PR #1022 head. Evidence records the exact head, workflow run/job conclusions, actual completion of all 13 package-coverage obligations, and the independent review conclusion without attributing agent review to a human.

A3: Before any tag is created, the Runtime-bound release plan consumes fresh evidence for this exact source/PR and confirms the real immutable v1.0.0 stable release is the N-1 source, v1.0.1 tag and Release names are unused, and the existing release workflow enforces candidate checks before public Release publication.

After normal PR merge and fresh Runtime publication admission only, create the new immutable v1.0.1 tag on the accepted merge commit. The existing workflow must build and pass candidate install/smoke for aarch64-apple-darwin (Homebrew), x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, and staged full N-1 upgrade from stable v1.0.0 must pass on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before public Release publication. Do not substitute N/A or another predecessor.

After public Release publication, download the official manifest, SHA256SUMS, and Linux x86_64 artifact; verify their identities and digests and pass public install plus N-1 upgrade from v1.0.0 with post-upgrade checks. Preserve any failure and never replace existing immutable assets.

On the local Apple Silicon macOS host, install the published macOS binary at the declared absolute path and update the CLI/MCP executable binding. Verify that official archive/manifest/SHA256SUMS agree, record the actual installed binary SHA-256 and version 1.0.1, confirm CLI absolute path and MCP initialize plus read-only request. Check a local build only for source/provenance/version; do not require its binary hash to equal the official artifact or mutate provider-global identity configuration.

After every release acceptance step succeeds, Runtime admits cleanup and close, and the exact merged PR branch/worktree cleanup plus final lifecycle receipts are recorded. No tag, release, or asset is overwritten or deleted.

previousContract.goal: Starting from main c417b65c3f3608b7fd2336314d7432fd72fa8723, make and verify the exact 16-path stable v1.0.1 update; pass exact-head repository CI and release gates; prove candidate build/install smoke for Apple Silicon macOS Homebrew, Linux x86_64 GNU, Linux ARM64 GNU, and Windows x86_64 MSVC; run full N-1 acceptance only on Linux x86_64; verify local macOS CLI/MCP identity switching; then publish stable v1.0.1 only after Runtime-admitted Contract review and current acceptance evidence. previousContract.intent: Prepare the existing v1.0.1 line as a genuine stable release rather than a prerelease, with corrected release identity and consistent localized version/distribution documentation.
outOfScope: Any product or governance path outside the 16-path allowlist; .github/workflows/release.yml unless a demonstrated defect requires a separately admitted amendment; editing historical evidence; merging before exact-head CI and required review; tagging or publishing before Contract review and candidate acceptance.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The exact candidate and declared 16 product paths identify stable 1.0.1 with no prerelease suffix; historical v1.0.0 and rc.2 remain distinct.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, release metadata, package/version source, the exact product diff, and localized release/version documents; preserve only accurate historical prerelease references.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Declared workspace verification and all required repository gates pass on the exact PR #1022 head, including actual coverage completion for all 13 packages and a non-blocking independent technical review.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Bind exact PR head SHA, current GitHub workflow run and every required job conclusion, Rust gate receipt, all 13 package-coverage outputs, and the available agent review conclusion. Do not claim a human approval from an agent review.

scenarioCoverage.expected: After Runtime publication admission, the new immutable v1.0.1 tag triggers four-target candidate install/smoke and those checks finish before public Release publication.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After merge and fresh Runtime admission only, create the new v1.0.1 tag once; retain the existing release workflow's candidate install/smoke outcome for aarch64-apple-darwin, both Linux targets, and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc before any public Release upload.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Staged N-1 upgrade from immutable stable v1.0.0 to candidate v1.0.1 passes only on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before the public Release is created.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: In the tag-triggered release workflow, verify its actual staged Linux x86_64 N-1 job installs previous stable v1.0.0, upgrades to candidate 1.0.1, and passes post-upgrade checks; never substitute N/A or another predecessor.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The local Apple Silicon macOS CLI and MCP run the official published stable v1.0.1 binary from its intended absolute path and pass initialize plus a read-only request.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After public release acceptance, install the official macOS asset; verify archive/manifest/SHA256SUMS, actual installed-binary SHA-256, version, absolute CLI path, and MCP initialize/read-only behavior. Do not compare its SHA-256 with an independent local build and do not change provider-global identity configuration.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only after all required pre-finish evidence and fresh Runtime publication admission, publish the new stable v1.0.1 tag/release with accepted workflow assets and without replacing existing immutable resources.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After candidate smoke and actual v1.0.0 N-1 succeed, inspect immutable tag/Release identity, downloaded public manifest/SHA256SUMS and archive digests; preserve failed evidence, never overwrite any tag or asset.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A downloaded public Linux x86_64 v1.0.1 asset verifies against its official manifest and SHA256SUMS, installs, and passes N-1 upgrade/post-upgrade checks from v1.0.0.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After the public Release exists, use the declared isolated adopter acceptance harness against the actual public Linux x86_64 asset; retain manifest/checksum/archive identity and install/upgrade/cleanup receipts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Before publication, a current Runtime-bound release plan consumes exact fresh CI/source evidence, selects immutable v1.0.0 as the real N-1 source, confirms stable v1.0.1 tag/Release names are unused, and retains candidate validation before public publication.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect current provider tag/Release identities and the existing release workflow; bind the exact candidate PR and evidence digests, all four target smoke jobs, and x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu staged N-1 from v1.0.0. No tag or publication mutation occurs in this pre-finish scenario.
